Name: Pharaoh Necho
Summary: Pharaoh-necho was king of Egypt whose army was defeated by Nebuchadnezzar at Carchemish by the Euphrates; Jeremiah's oracle against Egypt is dated to that battle, and Necho had earlier carried Shallum son of Josiah away to Egypt.
KeyStory: At Carchemish, Nebuchadnezzar smote the army of Pharaoh-necho, and Jeremiah declared that Egypt's day of the Lord's vengeance had come.
RelatedPeople: Shallum, Son of Josiah; King Nebuchadnezzar
LifeLesson: Egypt's power, like every empire's, had a Carchemish waiting for it.
